about.intro: Language Partner exists because the fastest way to learn a language is to actually speak it with another person. We connect learners for native-speaker exchange, peer practice, and structured self-paced courses — all in one place.
about.missionHeadline: Make authentic practice accessible to anyone, anywhere
about.missionBody: We match learners by language pair, level, and timezone, then get out of the way — built-in video and chat so there's nothing extra to install, and courses for whenever you want a bit more structure between sessions.

values.realBody: The fastest way to learn a language is to speak it with another human being — not tap through flashcards alone.
values.accessibleBody: Authentic conversation practice shouldn't require finding or affording a private tutor.
values.structureBody: Courses fill the gaps between conversations so you always have something to work on.

free.a: Yes. During our early access phase, every feature — exchange matching, peer practice, video calls, and courses — is completely free.

matching.a: We first try to match you with a native speaker of your target language who is learning your native language (an exchange match). If none are available, we suggest peer-practice partners who are learning the same language as you.

install.q: Do I need to install anything for video calls?
install.a: No. Calls run directly in your browser using WebRTC — no downloads or plugins required.

coursesOnly.q: Can I just use the video courses without talking to anyone?
coursesOnly.a: Absolutely. Courses are fully self-paced and independent of partner matching.
